annotation_firewall.rule: MACHINE_ADJUDICATED_PROVISIONAL, H1 and H2 results must be reported separately and never pooled in a primary score.

task_110_boundary.interpretation: Code, prompts, a pinned Qwen snapshot and a 185-case contract are technical/planning artifacts, not learned-generation, learned-agent or end-to-end results.

statistical_contract.small_sample_rule: Below 20 source videos all model comparisons are descriptive and carry a low-source warning.
statistical_contract.confirmatory_multiplicity: Holm correction over frozen primary learned-controller contrasts
statistical_contract.exploratory_multiplicity: BH only for explicitly exploratory secondary analyses

source_disjoint_split.group_definition: All mirrors, alternate encodings, excerpts, transcript variants, near-duplicate edits and families derived from one source program share one group.
rules: Assign complete source groups before prompt, retriever, fusion, threshold or mapper tuning on H2 outcomes.
No source group may occur in more than one split.
Every family, interval, transcript chunk, feature, query paraphrase and alternative SES inherits its source split.
Rejected candidates from test sources remain test-private and cannot be training negatives.
Do not duplicate a scarce modality or mechanism source across splits; acquire more sources or mark the stratum exploratory.
Public compatibility suites remain separate and unpooled.

practical_effect_thresholds.interpretation: These are practical-effect gates. Low-N mini-pilot results remain descriptive rather than significance claims.

claims.claim: AV-TRACE provides human-adjudicated matched evidence-access interventions that preserve the question, evidence graph, backend and budget while changing the reachability of a validated necessary route.
claims.acceptance_summary: H2 SES, necessity, modality and pair-isolation validation with no unresolved critical governance hold.

claims.claim: Answer correctness and supported-answer correctness diverge on held-out H2 families, so answer accuracy alone misses intervention-induced failures.
claims.acceptance_summary: Nonzero answer-correct but unsupported or invalid-citation cases across at least three source videos plus an intervention-aware practical separation not explained by retrieval recall.

claims.claim: Complete traces distinguish acquisition, utilization, citation, access-diagnosis and stopping failures.
claims.acceptance_summary: At least two independently adjudicated non-retrieval failure categories, each represented on at least two source videos and not wholly attributable to retrieval recall.

claims.claim: Matched restoration response is measurable with a common supported-answer endpoint and can be separated from BLOCKED diagnosis, no-trigger behavior and recovery cost.
claims.acceptance_summary: H2 pair isolation, learned action traces, no-trigger controls, common-endpoint restoration and independent replay across at least three source videos.

claims.claim: With shared backbone, backend, retrieval and budget, explicit evidence-sufficiency control improves at least one intervention-aware reliability metric without an unacceptable CLEAN supported-answer loss relative to learned ReAct.
claims.acceptance_summary: CLEAN loss no worse than 0.10 absolute and at least 0.15 absolute favorable difference in BLOCKED FSR, premature stop or common-endpoint restoration, with video-cluster uncertainty.

claims.claim: Retrieval coverage does not fully determine grounded success or recovery because systems with matched acquired observations differ in evidence use, citation, stopping or recovery.
claims.acceptance_summary: A non-retrieval separation persists under identical-observation or all-evidence-acquired analysis across multiple source videos.

claims.claim: For the tested encoders and corpus, generic learned modality retrieval does not consistently improve localization over task-aligned controls and may propagate degradation to grounded outcomes.
claims.acceptance_summary: Human-revalidated support registry, source-disjoint F-CTRL versus F-VA replication and end-to-end propagation analysis with bounded wording.

experiments.title: Current-state provenance and semantic freeze
acceptance_criteria: No machine-provisional artifact is labeled H1 or H2.
Task-110 implementation and contract are not represented as completed learned-agent results.
Restoration and premature-stop semantics match metrics protocol v0.3.0.

experiments.title: Deferred human construct-validity mini-pilot
inputs: candidate registry with 8-12 families from 5-6 source videos
acceptance_criteria: 8-12 families and at least 5 source-disjoint videos complete.
All five required identities complete their role for every family.
At least 75% of completed families reach H1.
At least 60% of completed families reach H2.
Pair-isolation failure is at most 10%.
No unresolved critical rights, privacy or safety hold.
No systematic minimality or modality failure affects more than 25% of completed families.

failure_decisions.CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_REPAIR: At least 40% reach H1 or failures are localized and repairable.
failure_decisions.CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_NO_GO: Fewer than 40% reach H1, at least half are rejected, or systematic construct or governance failure occurs.

experiments.title: H2 pair-isolation, recovery-route and certificate audit
acceptance_criteria: Every accepted H2 family has at least one reachable CLEAN SES.
Every BLOCKED episode closes all accepted routes through the selected necessity group or channel.
Every RESTORED episode begins identically to BLOCKED and restores only the registered route.
No-trigger controls do not restore complete support.
Two validator trajectories succeed per accepted family.
All primary premature-stop episodes have valid route certificates or are explicitly null.

experiments.title: Learned evidence-conditioned generator readiness audit
acceptance_criteria: Actual pinned Qwen inference is used through the isolated JSONL boundary.
Model-authored claims, citations, sufficiency and diagnosis pass strict validation.
Complete evidence, partial evidence, blocked evidence, distractor and malformed-output cases are completed.
At most one bounded repair is used.
Timeout and OOM handling are typed and fail closed.
Independent metric recomputation and leakage audit pass.
No deterministic answer substitution occurs.

experiments.title: Learned ReAct and evidence-sufficiency controller readiness audit
acceptance_criteria: Both learned controllers use the same frozen backbone, backend, candidate universe, tool schema, budget and failure handling.
Actions are genuinely model-selected and prompts and configurations are independently hashed.
Complete action traces exist for all states and no-trigger controls.
Timeout, malformed action, unavailable channel, OOM, over-budget and process-crash cases fail closed.
Strict final-point feasibility and premature-stop scoring pass independent audit.
Evaluator-private state, family, intervention, evidence, answer and trigger fields are not exposed.

experiments.title: H2-primary end-to-end matched mini diagnostic
acceptance_criteria: CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_MINI_PILOT_GO, LEARNED_GENERATION_READY and LEARNED_AGENT_READY are all true.
Intervention effects are visible across at least three source-disjoint videos and are not wholly attributable to one family.
At least one separation is not explained by retrieval recall alone.
There is a nonzero set of H2 cases where answer correctness differs from supported-answer correctness or citation validity.
At least two non-retrieval failure categories are observed, each on at least two source videos.
Video-cluster descriptive uncertainty and complete invalid and missing-run accounting are reported.

experiments.title: Scale-up feasibility and throughput gate
acceptance_criteria: CONSTRUCT_VALIDITY_MINI_PILOT_GO and END_TO_END_DIAGNOSTIC_GO are true.
A credible unchanged-threshold route exists to 20-30 rights-cleared videos and 60 H2 families.
Reviewer and rights-review capacity is documented.
Sampling, split, modality and mechanism strata, reserve and precision plans are frozen.
Scale is not justified by a desired model ranking.

experiments.title: Source-group deduplication and split freeze
acceptance_criteria: Zero source-group overlap across development, validation and test.
Zero unresolved near-duplicate cross-split finding.
At least 8, 4 and 8 source videos and 24, 12 and 24 target H2 families in development, validation and test at minimum scale.
Any unavailable split stratum is labeled exploratory rather than duplicated across splits.

experiments.title: Scaled H2 corpus construction and freeze
acceptance_criteria: At least 60 frozen H2 families from at least 20 source-disjoint videos.
No construct threshold is weakened to fill quotas.
Every test family is H2 before test execution.
Every primary source has an approved rights decision for the intended use.
All rejection, repair and hold reasons are retained.

experiments.title: Main-study system, threshold and artifact freeze
acceptance_criteria: At least four learned system classes are frozen.
At least two model or backbone families appear in the final paper evaluation.
All prompts, models, retrieval, budgets, practical thresholds and invalid-run rules are frozen before test outcomes.
No test family or test-derived artifact has been used for tuning.

experiments.title: Primary held-out Acquire Ground Act dashboard
acceptance_criteria: All metrics use preregistered denominators and H2 test families only.
Family contrasts are aggregated within source before video-cluster inference.
Every state, modality, mechanism and invalid-run denominator is disclosed.
No weighted primary scalar is used.

experiments.title: Answer-versus-supported-answer and failure-stage analysis
acceptance_criteria: A nonzero answer-versus-supported-answer or citation divergence occurs across at least three source videos for MC2.
At least two non-retrieval failure categories occur across at least two source videos each for MC3.
The taxonomy is independently audited from complete traces.

experiments.title: Matched intervention and learned-controller contrast
acceptance_criteria: For a directional MC5 claim, CLEAN supported-answer loss is no worse than 0.10 absolute.
For a directional MC5 claim, at least one eligible intervention metric improves by at least 0.15 absolute.
The effect is not driven by one source under leave-one-source-out analysis.
Video-cluster confidence intervals and Holm-adjusted confirmatory inference are reported.

experiments.title: Human-revalidated retrieval replication
acceptance_criteria: Support labels are H2 and include all adjudicated alternative SESs.
At least five source videos contribute to any reported modality stratum.
F-CTRL and F-VA are evaluated without test-family tuning.
Any claim is bounded to the tested encoders, query construction and corpus.

experiments.title: Retrieval propagation and identical-observation ablation
acceptance_criteria: For MC6, at least one Ground or Act difference persists when acquired observations are identical or All-Evidence Success is one.
For MC7, any retrieval degradation or improvement is traced to end-to-end outcomes without claiming universal encoder quality.
Alternative-SES-aware scoring is the primary retrieval interpretation.

experiments.title: Stopping, sufficiency-component and budget ablations
acceptance_criteria: Every ablation changes only the preregistered component.
Budget curves use separate frozen runs rather than retrospective truncation.
Normative stopping results use valid route certificates and typed terminal exceptions only.

experiments.title: Failure injection, replay and invalid-run audit
acceptance_criteria: No injected failure produces a silent success or deterministic answer substitution.
All failures are typed and included in primary invalid-run accounting.
Independent replay reproduces valid completed trajectories within declared tolerance.

experiments.title: Independent paper-claim, leakage, metric and release audit
acceptance_criteria: Every abstract and conclusion claim maps to a passed claim entry and frozen result.
Independent metric recomputation matches within declared tolerance.
No unresolved critical evaluator-private leakage exists.
Negative, null, excluded and invalid strata are disclosed.
A dated related-work audit rejects unsupported first, unique and SOTA language.
Release claims match asset-level authorization and restricted artifacts are not called public.

negative_result_branches.action: Stop scale-up and do not make benchmark-valid, minimality, necessity or modality claims.
Version and rerun the affected protocol and do not pool incompatible pre- and post-repair records.
Rebuild support registries before interpreting retrieval misses and consider provisional-label incompleteness as a finding.
Treat modalities as routing or corroboration strata and drop necessity claims.
Do not claim end-to-end learned-agent behavior and do not substitute deterministic outputs.
Reject the strong end-to-end thesis and reframe around retrieval localization, protocol construction or a null agent-policy result.
Report the null or adverse result and retain only supported protocol and cross-system findings.
Drop the encoder degradation claim and report provisional support-registry error.
Remove headline generalization and acquire more sources before submission.
Do not call the assets a public benchmark core or make population ranking claims.

prohibited_claims: AV-TRACE is already a validated benchmark.
Current NOAA families contain human-gold minimal SESs or necessity groups.
Machine agreement or machine counterfactual validation equals H1 or H2.
Current modality-routing labels prove modality necessity.
The current benchmark distinguishes source evidence absence from access failure.
Task-110 implementation or its frozen contract proves learned generation or learned-agent readiness.
SigLIP2 or CLAP is generally superior or inferior for long-video retrieval.
RESTORED supported-answer success minus BLOCKED diagnostic success is restoration gain.
Any first, unique, only, SOTA, universal reliability or population-wide superiority claim.
Current restricted media, transcripts, annotations, vectors or model weights are authorized for redistribution.
Machine-provisional, H1 and H2 outcomes may be pooled in a primary score.
Episodes or families from one source video are statistically independent.
Held-out test families may be used for prompt, retriever, fusion, threshold or mapper tuning.
Negative, null, excluded or invalid strata may be omitted.
